blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senators welcomed the enactment of the Basic Education Voucher Assistance Act, or Republic Act No. 12327, saying it would expand access to quality education while helping ease overcrowding in public schools. Pangilinan, a co-author of Senate Bill No. 1981, the Senate’s consolidated measure that became the basis of the law, stressed the need to ensure that government assistance reaches students and families who need it most. These include qualified students from 4Ps households, Indigenous Peoples communities, learners with disabilities, and those living in geographically isolated and disadvantaged areas (GIDAs).
